description: Numbers in tarot, Ace to Ten: what each number tends to signal across the four suits, and how to combine a number with a suit to read an unfamiliar card.
lede: Each number from Ace to Ten carries a theme that repeats in every tarot suit. Knowing them helps you read a minor arcana card you have not met before.

numbers.alt: Ten tiles in order, Ace to Ten, each with its keywords: Ace, beginnings; Two, balance and choice; Three, growth and teamwork; Four, stability and pause; Five, conflict and change; Six, harmony and movement; Seven, reflection and challenge; Eight, skill and momentum; Nine, resilience and near completion; Ten, completion and overload.
numbers.caption: The same ten themes apply in all four suits. Combine the number with the suit to get a first reading of any minor arcana card.
